name: rank-candidates
title: Rank a list against a brief, cutting weak picks, duplicates and full buckets

origin.source: Original pattern: typed judgments for fuzzy ranking, code for the exact parts

comparison.purpose: Jev decides, code sorts: Jev scores each candidate's fit to the brief and judges whether two shortlisted candidates are the same thing, while thresholds, sorting, pairing, per-bucket quotas and the top-k cut-off are plain code. Every candidate either makes the list or is cut with a reason.
